claims.source_quote_ar: فاستعار النفل له على طريق التصريحية
claims.claim_ar: استعارة لفظة «النفل» لبيان معنى الغنيمة، أي تشبيه الثواب والعطاء الإلهي بالنفل (هبة طوعية) لتقريب المعنى وزيادة التصور البلاغي لما يُغنم
claims.claim_en: Metaphor (istiarah): the commentator treats the term 'النفل' as a metaphor for the spoils ('غَنِمْتُمْ'), likening divine reward/gain to a voluntary gift to make the concept more vivid.

claims.source_quote_ar: وإنما يذكر أحدهما مع الآخر للتوكيد
claims.claim_ar: تكرار ذكر «لِلَّهِ» مع «وَلِلرَّسُولِ» مقصود للتوكيد والمساواة في الحث على الإنفاق والالتزام بتقسيم الخمس
claims.claim_en: Repetition (takrar): mentioning 'to Allah' together with 'and to the Messenger' is done for emphasis — pairing the two increases assertiveness of the distribution and the duty.

claims.claim_ar: حذف خبر «فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ» (خبر محذوف) مستخدم بلاغياً للإيجاز والتوكيد؛ الحذف يزيد في قوة القول ويعطي إحساساً بثبوت ووجوب الخمس
claims.claim_en: Conciseness/ellipsis (ijaaz): the commentator notes that the predicate after 'فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ' is omitted. This ellipsis functions rhetorically to create concision and strengthen the assertion that one-fifth belongs to God.
claims.needs_review_reason: Labeling the omitted-predicate phenomenon as 'ijaaz' (conciseness) is interpretative; the source explicitly notes the omission but does not use the modern category name—could be alternatively labelled simply as 'ellipsis' or 'tawqīd (emphasis)'.

warnings: Provided source chunks are from Zamakhsharī (al-Kashshaf) and Safi (al-Jadwal). The user requested extraction from al-Jurjānī, al-Sakkākī, al-Baqillānī, al-Suyūṭī and tafsir-balagha; those authors' materials were not present among the provided chunks.

Some rhetorical-type mappings (for example mapping the noted omission to the specific category 'ijaaz') are interpretative because the commentator describes the grammatical phenomenon (خبر محذوف) rather than naming a specific classical rhetorical label from the requested taxonomy; such mappings are marked with lower confidence and a needs_review_reason.
